If imm26-4080-i4op9 stays silent or stuck, respawn a fresh operator (name not in this file, use <new>): powershell -NoProfile -File C:/KenshiModding/tools/automation/lane-brief.ps1 4080-i4 -Out C:/KenshiTestRuns/agents/<new>.brief.md -Name <new> -Predecessor imm26-4080-i4op9.
